artifacts.summary: 7-phase plan applying the 5-widen/3-retire state-schema ruling, the advisory-first Checks 3/4 posture, the postflight blockers reader/comment fix, a consumer-runnable migration script, and a new schema-to-validator drift test.

memory_candidates.content: In the agent-system source store, several pairs of definitions are kept byte-equal BY HAND with no drift test, and each pair is a latent silent-failure site. The known pairs: context/schemas/state-schema.json's property key sets vs scripts/validate-state.sh's KNOWN_TOP_LEVEL_FIELDS/KNOWN_ENTRY_FIELDS arrays (validate-state.sh's own comment admits the hand-sync and the missing drift test), and the status enum vs scripts/lib/status-vocabulary.sh (this one IS guarded, by scripts/tests/test-status-vocabulary.sh). Concrete evidence the unguarded pair drifts: research_questions has been modelled in state-schema.json since the needs_research feature landed but was never added to KNOWN_ENTRY_FIELDS, so any repo whose planner returned a needs_research verdict gets an unexplained validator FAIL on a field the schema explicitly models. When planning any schema or vocabulary widening in this repo, treat the paired hand-maintained list as part of the same phase (they must move together) and add a set-equality drift test modelled on test-status-vocabulary.sh; do not assume a schema edit alone is sufficient.
